desc: The Bushmaster BA50 Bolt Action Rifle is one of the world’s finest weapons for long-range shooting. The BA50 is a highly modular rifle and uses fire controls that are familiar to all AR platform users. New improvements to the bolt design bring effortless bolt operation, with improved extraction and cartridge feeding. The BA50 includes a Magpul PRS Gen3 Adjustable Stock, a 29” free-floating barrel topped with a picatinny rail, and a Bushmaster BA50 3-Port Brake. Maintenance, takedown and assembly of the BA50 is intuitive and straight forward. Re-engineered to be reliable, durable and long lasting, the Bushmaster BA50 provides an enjoyable shooting experience that is ideal for the .50 Caliber shooter looking for an affordable price point.
